mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.2% signals a tightening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected inflationary pressures.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between UNRATE and inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.2%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 115 signals strengthening economic output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO > 115, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.25-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST, RSAFS, and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 5.5% signals tightening monetary policy, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS > 135000) signals a labor market at full capacity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected wage pressures.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between labor market and wage inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3.5% signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2.5-year rolling window during mid-cycle expansions, or 20-day forward returns when GDPC1 > 3.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in this regime.
